domain: fixed positive real z; meromorphic epsilon continuation from 1/2<Re(eps)<1
normalization: fixed CA^2*CF channel; sym=4; exactly one Euler factor

full_epsilon.convergence: initial absolute convergence strip; finite signed blocks before outer sums; then meromorphic continuation
full_epsilon.numerical_limitations: no accelerated summation or rigorous infinite-tail enclosure

hlog_encoding.convention: real iterated integrals for z>0; Hlog(z,[0]*n)=log(z)^n/n!

period_definitions.A4: sum_{n>=1} (-1)^n*H_{n-1}/n^3 = integral_0^1 log(1/t)*log(1+t)^2/(2*t) dt = HyperInt zeta[1,-3]
period_definitions.A6: sum_{n>=1} (-1)^n*H_{n-1}/n^5 = integral_0^1 log(1/t)^3*log(1+t)^2/(12*t) dt = HyperInt zeta[1,-5]
